methods.label: Distinctness of set elements
methods.explanation: The elements of a set are distinct. \(\{1,2,2\}\) and \(\{1,2\}\) are the same set, and the repeated 2 counts as only 1 element.
methods.levelReason: This directly applies the distinctness property within the stated introductory set scope.
